result.title: A Geometric Theory for Nonequilibrium Transformer Dynamics
result.comment: 29 pages Submitted to Proc Roy Soc A
result.summary: We develop a variational and geometric theory based on statistical physics for the joint evolution of Transformer attention and token representations at fixed model parameters. To this end, we introduce a free energy for the attention and model the evolution of the attention weights by its Fisher--Rao gradient flow. At fixed token representations, we prove that the softmax matrix is the unique free-energy minimiser and that every positive attention trajectory converges to it. For prescribed time-dependent representations, we show that the attention dynamics becomes linear after a change to logit variables. This result yields tracking bounds relative to the instantaneous softmax and sufficient conditions for attention to converge to a fixed matrix. Hamiltonian dynamics for the representations and their momenta are then coupled to the attention relaxation driven by the same energy. This coupling results in an energy-dissipation law. We also develop two alternative Hamiltonians incorporating the attention value map. We prove global well-posedness of the attention flow and all three coupled systems.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用统计物理与变分视角刻画固定参数下 Transformer 注意力权重与 token 表示的联合演化：以自由能和 Fisher–Rao 梯度流建模注意力，证明 softmax 是唯一自由能极小点、给出注意力对瞬时 softmax 的跟踪界，并把表示与动量的 Hamilton 动力学与注意力松弛耦合，得到能量耗散律与适定性结论。
AI.relevance_reason: 其注意力收敛性、logit 变量线性化与能量耗散分析，可能为核查 LVR 中多步 latent 更新时注意力结构随深度的稳定性与状态演化提供可借用的理论工具；但该文纯理论、不涉及视觉或多模态，可迁移性需核查。
